piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS AGAIN, ARORA STILL STANDS
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora scored the worst week of his season, 32, and Neol did worse with 29. The lead went from 18 to 21. Sukrut sits third in the table. Nobody has made the leader pay for a bad week yet.

piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS ON 92 ARMBANDS, ARORA STILL CLEAR
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked on 92 armbands, the leader had a poor week, and the chasers still couldn't close the gap.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora: Alone at the top for 5 weeks in a row, since GW7. Karan Singh: 14th in GW8, down to 21st by GW9, back up to 7th now.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Krishna won Bench Disaster. A full week of points sat out on the bench, the most in the league. One for the team sheet next time.
piece.one_to_watch: Karan Singh holds the last Top prizes place by 1 point over Kshiteesh. Kshiteesh was in the zone for 4 of the last 5 weeks, so one good week could swing it back.

title.title: Arora Stretches Clear
title.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol 734 to 716, a gap of 18 after it grew from 16 last gameweek. Third-placed Aryan Khamankar sits 27 points off the top, and Arora has now led for 4 weeks running.
title.next: If Arora's lead keeps growing, the chasing pack may need a major swing to catch up.

title.title: Neol Cuts the Gap
title.text: Rajat Arora still leads Neol by 15 points, down from 21 last week, after 6 weeks at the top. Sukrut sits 18 points back in third, so the lead is shrinking but not gone.
title.next: 15 points. That's the gap Neol must close.

underdog:4722308.title: Biswadeep Keeps Rising
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep has climbed from 85th in GW1 to 6th of 113 managers, a rise of 79 places. The move from 11th to 6th in the last week puts a top-5 finish within reach.
underdog:4722308.next: If the climb continues, Biswadeep could break into the top 5 before the season ends.

underdog:4722308.title: Biswadeep's Climb Stalls
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep has climbed 78 places from 85th in GW1 to 7th of 113 managers. After being 6th last week, a slip to 7th shows the top-5 push has hit a bump.
underdog:4722308.next: If Biswadeep wins back a place or 2, a top-5 finish stays in view.

underdog:4722308.title: Climb Hits a Wall
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep has dropped from 7th to 9th of 113 managers this week, after climbing from 85th in GW1. The top-5 push has stalled, and the 76 places gained so far are still the story.
underdog:4722308.next: Does Biswadeep's climb resume next week?

chase:18991.title: Arshad closes in fast
chase:18991.text: Arshad has cut Adrian's lead from 48 in GW7 to 39, then 24, and now just 2. Adrian is still ahead, but the chase has never been closer.

gold.title: Prathap Holds The Line
gold.text: Prathap is the last manager inside the top 9, with Cherag first out just 2 points behind. Cherag has spent 4 of the last 5 gameweeks in the zone, while Prathap has spent only one.
gold.next: Cherag could edge back into the top 9 and push Prathap out of the final place.

gold.title: Karan Singh Takes The Spot
gold.text: Karan Singh has taken the last top-prize place from Kshiteesh, who dropped out this week. The gap between them is just 1 point, and Kshiteesh has spent 4 of the last 5 gameweeks inside the zone.
gold.next: Will Kshiteesh's 4 weeks of form be enough?

gold.title: Level on the Last Spot
gold.text: Karan Singh holds the 9th and final top-prize place, with Biswadeep first out and level on points. Utkarsh has just come into the zone this week, adding fresh pressure.

champions.title: Cherag's Title Chance
champions.text: Cherag is the best-placed former champion, sitting 10th with 2 titles from 2018-19 and 2015-16. Kunaal has 4 titles but is 56th, while Zorawar and Bhavin are 36th and 33rd.
champions.next: Cherag could climb further and turn a top-10 place into a real push for the title.

champions.title: Cherag Leads The Champions
champions.text: Cherag remains the best-placed former champion in 10th, with 2 titles. Kunaal, who has 4 titles, is 49th, while Zorawar sits 36th and Bhavin 34th.
champions.next: Cherag could push further up the table, but the other former champions have a long way to climb.

chase:3991082.title: Sukrut Closes to 3
chase:3991082.text: Sukrut trails Yash Bhatia by just 3 points after GW10, down from 60 in GW7. The gap has shrunk every week since, with 37 in GW8 and 18 in GW9.
chase:3991082.next: If Sukrut overtakes Yash next week, the chase ends and the lead changes hands.

slump:10615.title: Maanas Searches For Form
slump:10615.text: Maanas has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. After a low of 42 in GW8, points rose to 52 and then 55 in GW10.
slump:10615.next: Another strong week could start a recovery, but another dip would deepen the slump.

slump:10615.title: Maanas Stays Stuck
slump:10615.text: Maanas has now been below the league average for 7 weeks in a row. After rising to 55 in GW10, this week's 36 wiped out that recovery and matched the GW5 total.
slump:10615.next: 36 points again. The slump is not over yet.

slump:10615.title: Stuck in the Slump
slump:10615.text: Maanas has now been below the league average for 7 weeks in a row. This week's 36 wiped out the recovery to 55 in GW10 and matched the GW5 total.
slump:10615.next: Can Maanas finally break out of the slump?

rivalry:107315-780469.title: Sahej And Sahil Level
rivalry:107315-780469.text: Sahej and Sahil are level on points in GW10, after Sahej led by 17 a week earlier. They have swapped places 6 times this season, so the rivalry remains wide open.
rivalry:107315-780469.next: Whoever makes the next move could take control of this rivalry.

rivalry:780469-1541394.title: Sahil Holds, Nanik Strikes
rivalry:780469-1541394.text: Sahil leads Nanik by 4 points, down from a 9-point lead last week after Nanik cut the gap. The 2 have swapped places 8 times this season, so neither has settled this rivalry.
rivalry:780469-1541394.next: Does Nanik strike again, or does Sahil hold?

hot:4722308.title: Biswadeep's Hot Run
hot:4722308.text: Biswadeep has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with points of 79 in GW10 and a peak of 81 in GW6. The streak has survived a dip to 51 in GW8.
hot:4722308.next: If the points stay strong, the streak could stretch further and push Biswadeep up the table.

chase:1325491.title: Akshat Closes The Gap
chase:1325491.text: Akshat trails Neol by just 3 points, down from 35 in GW8, 18 in GW9 and 14 in GW10. Each week the gap has shrunk sharply, bringing this chase close to a decision.
chase:1325491.next: If Akshat overtakes Neol, the second-place fight could flip immediately.

hot:573491.title: Nihal's Hot Run Cools
hot:573491.text: Nihal has now been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row. Points fell from 67 to 50 this week, though the streak is still going.
hot:573491.next: If Nihal's points rebound, the streak could stretch further.

ghosts.title: 4 Managers Gone Quiet
ghosts.text: Aritra, Rohan, Janak and Janit have all gone inactive, with Aritra the biggest slide. Aritra now sits 112th, a long way from a best of 62nd this season.
ghosts.next: Will any of the 4 wake up before the run-in?

ghosts.title: Silence Continues
ghosts.text: Aritra, Rohan, Janak and Janit remain inactive, and Aritra now sits 111th of 113 managers. That is far from his best of 62nd this season.
ghosts.next: If they return, Aritra could start to claw back ground.

chase:780469.title: Sahil Nearly There
chase:780469.text: Sahil has cut Quseem's lead from 41 points in GW9 to just 1 point now. The chase has gone from a distant prospect to a single result away.
chase:780469.next: 1 point. That's all Sahil needs to overtake.
